description: RNIT AI Solutions Limited received a government contract from Andhra Pradesh Technology Services to develop and maintain modules for the Commissionerate of Collegiate Education for five years.
body_lead: RNIT AI Solutions shares jump after winning e-governance project with Andhra Pradesh government News by Aliceblue News Desk 11 Mar 2026 Introduction Leading AI solutions company secured a government contract in Andhra Pradesh to design, develop, and maintain modules for the Commissionerate of Collegiate Education over five years. Also Read: KPI Green Energy jumps 3% after launching additional 24.2 MW AC capacity under GUVNL Share price movement of RNIT AI Solutions On March 11, 2026, RNIT AI Solutions Ltd opened at ₹50.80, up 3.05% from its previous close of ₹49.31.
